people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

translations.web: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”
translations.bsb: But Absalom, the man we anointed over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about restoring the king?”
translations.kjv: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing ➔ the king back?
